description: We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. In this vital dual role, you will be instrumental in both enhancing staff competency through comprehensive education and ensuring the highest standards of infection prevention and control within our facility.This position offers a unique opportunity to directly impact patient safety and quality of care. You will be responsible for developing and implementing staff education programs, conducting infection surveillance, and ensuring compliance with all relevant health regulations, fostering a safe and knowledgeable environment for both residents and staff.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2 years of experience in staff development or education
Minimum of 2 years of experience in infection control within a healthcare setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal infection control regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.
